note: Generic 1.20.1 -> 1.21.1 packet-NBT widening. In 1.21.1 PacketByteBuf.writeNbt takes NbtElement instead of NbtCompound, so old calls with the narrower descriptor fail to link.

methodRedirects.evidence: IronChests chest open (runs/p67-ironchests-gui-nbt): after the sync-NBT redirect, SyncableData.sync writes its tag with NoSuchMethodError 'net.minecraft.class_2540 net.minecraft.class_2540.method_10794(net.minecraft.class_2487)'. 1.21.1 declares method_10794(NbtElement) only; NbtCompound is an NbtElement, so the bridge widens the argument and keeps the same PacketByteBuf return.
